A clean, crisp digital gouache illustration for a video game background, looking down at about forty degrees across a coulee in a dry basalt tableland, inspired by the Channeled Scablands. Sheer cliffs of dark brown-grey columnar basalt cut across flat plateaus of gold grass and grey-green sagebrush. Each cliff shows two or three stacked lava flows: a band of tall, regular, hexagonal columns standing side by side, topped by a band of broken, irregular rock. The sun is in the upper left, so every column is lit on its left face and in shade on its right face. A pale rim of rock runs along the top edge of each cliff and fans of lighter broken talus spill from its foot. A small stream runs along the coulee floor. No buildings, no roads, no fences, no people.
